message:
prover/layergkr: an ext column for bridge-held weights; the sumcheck verifier checks the round count

The composition instrument and the layout breakdown share one walk over
the claims' variables; a weight the bridge holds (Variable.external) is a
prover input and never a witness row, and the walk classified it as a
committed activation. The composition now has an ext column and the
layout breakdown skips external variables, as the layout itself does.

verify_terms and the single-product verify iterated over whatever rounds
the transcript carried and never compared their number with log2 of the
domain; mle_eval folds only over the point it is given, so a zero-round
transcript was accepted whenever the product at index 0 matched the
claim. Both now require exactly log2(size) rounds and equal factor sizes.
The gap predates the merge. Locked by test_short_transcript_rejects.
